result.one_liner: Monday.com is a cloud-based work OS / project management platform with a GraphQL API for managing boards, items, columns, users, and workspaces.

evidence.quote: Personal tokens allow you to interact with the API using your own user account.
request authorization to read or modify data in a user's monday account
Admin, member, and guest users are all able to utilize the monday.com API
The monday.com API is built with GraphQL, a flexible query language that allows you to return as much or as little data as you need.
monday.com provides two MCP servers: monday apps MCP for building, configuring, and deploying monday apps... and monday platform MCP for managing boards, items, and workflows with AI
Navigate to your profile - Developers - Developer Center - API token - Show

result.notes: Auth is via personal V2 API tokens (passed in Authorization header) for individual/self-serve use, plus full OAuth2 flow for published apps requiring client ID/secret from the Developer Center. Free developer account gives immediate API + OAuth app creation access, no sales/partner gate. Official hosted MCP server available at mcp.monday.com/mcp (github.com/mondaycom/mcp) plus a separate monday-apps MCP for building apps. API breadth not explicitly enumerated in docs; classified medium based on GraphQL schema scope (boards/items/columns/users/workspaces/updates/webhooks) and third-party tool wrappers (~125 actions).
